apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Build 171 (1.1.171) introduces end-to-end Cloud G-Sync and ProMotion VRR support: wires Cloud G-Sync to NVST RTSP ANNOUNCE and CloudMatch session provisioning, enables dynamic ProMotion Variable Refresh Rate (48-120Hz) on Metal 4 / CADisplayLink, prevents false Metal 4 fallbacks during transient frame dips, and adds an in-stream Cloud G-Sync toggle. Retains controller rumble and split touchpad. Unsigned Release IPA for KravaSigner.
